result.summary: Refactors transaction construction in three test files and one benchmark to use declarative initializer lists rather than vector resizing and post-hoc field mutation. It touches `descriptor_tests`, `bip352_tests`, `group_outputs_tests`, and the `mempool_ephemeral_spends` benchmark without altering transaction contents or test behaviour.
result.problem: Test and benchmark transactions across several files are built imperatively via `resize()` followed by member assignments or in-place mutations, obscuring transaction structures and default values.
evidence: Part of #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data')
result.scope_notes: Small mechanical cleanup across four test and benchmark files.
result.changed_since_previous: Diff provided for review; commits and contents match the previous description.
result.card: This PR refactors transaction input and output construction in descriptor tests, BIP352 tests, group output tests, and an ephemeral spends benchmark to use declarative list initialization instead of vector resizing and member mutation. It is purely an internal test cleanup contributing to tracking issue #36692, with no change to benchmark or test behavior. It has low risk and no external dependencies.

risk.why: Touches only unit tests and a benchmark file without modifying node runtime or consensus logic.
